title: Implement Database Schema for Financial Dashboard
description: Design and implement the database schema to store income, expenses, and net worth data for the financial dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Database schema is designed and documented.
Tables for income, expenses, and net worth are created and functional.
Database is integrated with the application backend.

sub_tasks.title: Design database schema and entity relationships
sub_tasks.description: 🚨 CRITICAL: FIRST read .projexlight/context/requirements.md to understand the specific requirements for "Implement Database Schema for Financial Dashboard". Look for the task's acceptance criteria and implement according to those exact specifications. 🚨 CRITICAL: FIRST read .projexlight/schemas/user-defined-schemas.sql and init-scripts/01-schema.sql to check for EXISTING tables. REUSE existing tables by adding columns instead of creating new ones. Only create new tables if absolutely necessary. Then create ERD, define tables, columns, types, constraints, and relationships based on the specific requirements and acceptance criteria

sub_tasks.title: Create database migration scripts
sub_tasks.description: 🚨 CRITICAL: FIRST check .projexlight/schemas/user-defined-schemas.sql for existing tables. REUSE and ALTER existing tables instead of creating duplicates. Write SQL migration scripts only for NEW tables or columns that don't exist
dependencies: MANDATORY: Verify no duplicate tables by checking schema file first

sub_tasks.title: Implement data models and TypeScript interfaces
sub_tasks.description: 🚨 CRITICAL: Read .projexlight/schemas/user-defined-schemas.sql to understand existing table structure. Create TypeScript models that match the EXISTING database schema. Do not create models for tables that don't exist in the schema
dependencies: Task 0: Server and database setup must be complete
MANDATORY: Models must match schema file structure
